translations.web: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”
translations.bsb: And as soon as the grain is ripe, he swings the sickle, because the harvest has come.”
translations.kjv: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.
translations.asv: But when the fruit is ripe, straightway he putteth forth the sickle, because the harvest is come.
